summary_en: Proposes CMHD, a lightweight cross-modal heterogeneous distillation framework in which a high-capacity RGB teacher transfers semantic supervision to a sonar student during training. Branch-aware distillation is restricted to objectness and classification to avoid unreliable localization transfer caused by RGB-sonar geometric mismatch. The final model uses sonar alone at inference and reports 79.6% mAP and 82.6% mAR on the UXO multimodal dataset.
publication_note: High-confidence camera-sonar backfill. Directly relevant to cross-modal acoustic-optical perception, but recommended for candidates rather than immediate main-library promotion because the contribution is downstream sonar object detection via training-time RGB distillation rather than joint acoustic-optical image formation or reconstruction.
